what: The organisers' answers to our four rules questions, and what each one does to our entries

source.from: Shalin Jain <shalinj@nvidia.com>, cc v2d_challenge@nvidia.com and mverghese@nvidia.com

answers_verbatim.1_tier_appropriate_references: Using derived from the tier's own released file is fine, with no read of any other tier's data.
answers_verbatim.2_tier1_inputs: Yes, using strictly less information than Tier 1 permits is okay!
answers_verbatim.3_ground_truth_meshes: For Tier 3, we ask that you do not use the ground truth mesh for training as the intent is to evaluate directly from video, the hardest setting for this track. You may use the ground truth mesh for metric computations and frame alignment.
answers_verbatim.4_tie_handling: All tied teams receive the same rank, and the next rank skips appropriately, there will not be consideration of submission time.

consequences.tier2_entry: VALID as uploaded. The cleaner reads only the Tier 2 trajectory and the Tier 2 support primitives (src/v2d/clean/support_contact.py:294, pinned by tests/test_tier2_reads_no_tier1.py), which is the permitted reading of answer 1.
consequences.tier1_entry: VALID as uploaded. 16 of 30 clips are driven by the bridge-cleaned Tier 2 reference, i.e. strictly less information than Tier 1 permits -- confirmed by answer 2.
consequences.e01_e29_cross_tier_substitution: UN-SHELVED as a rules matter by answer 2. Legality was the only objection recorded in docs/FINAL_COMPLIANCE.md; it is now answered in writing.
consequences.ranking_rule: CONFIRMED by answer 4. docs/RANKING_RULE.md no longer contains an inference, and the step-function consequence (a gain pays nothing until it crosses a distinct score) is load-bearing.
consequences.tier3_entry: NON-COMPLIANT, confirmed in writing 2026-11-03. Answer 3 plus the follow-up disallow both of our two remaining mesh uses. The entry stands on the public board because Kaggle submissions cannot be withdrawn, but it must not be named as a final submission on the technical-report form, and the organisers should be told plainly.

tier3_mesh_uses.use: AUC vertices and the one frame-0 rigid alignment transform
tier3_mesh_uses.why: answer 3 permits the mesh for metric computations and frame alignment, explicitly

tier3_mesh_uses.use: the CAD model input to FoundationPose, which produces the per-frame object track from the exo video
tier3_mesh_uses.why: neither a metric computation nor frame alignment; it gives the tracker exact object shape and scale, which the stated intent ('evaluate directly from video') withholds -- CONFIRMED disallowed by the 2026-11-03 reply.

tier3_mesh_uses.use: the object's visual and collision geometry in the simulator while the policy trains
tier3_mesh_uses.where: src/v2d/retarget/sequences.py:270 copies the released mesh to reconstructed_mesh/output_aligned.glb
tier3_mesh_uses.why: this is the ground truth mesh used for training, in the plainest sense of answer 3. Not disclosed in our first email; the directory is named reconstructed_mesh and holds the released mesh. -- CONFIRMED disallowed by the 2026-11-03 reply.

tier3_mesh_uses.use: the object's identity (e.g. 'big_red_bowl') as the open-set detection text prompt
tier3_mesh_uses.where: meta/episodes_metadata.jsonl, read by the Tier 3 detection stage
tier3_mesh_uses.why: not asked about in the first email; the 2026-11-03 reply volunteers that AI-generated subject names are the intended alternative, so the released name is not admissible either. A third independent reason the current Tier 3 entry cannot be claimed.

follow_up_sent.asks: whether use (b) the tracker input and use (c) the simulator geometry are permitted, each named separately
follow_up_sent.states: that if they are not, we will rebuild Tier 3 on our own reconstruction or withdraw the tier before the freeze
follow_up_sent.also_offers: the object name from meta/episodes_metadata.jsonl, used only as the open-set detection prompt, for the same scrutiny

held_pending_that_answer.staged_at: $S/ws_t3n, 449 MB, 13 of 13 parquets and support USDAs manifest-verified
held_pending_that_answer.why_held: fine-tuning on a reference that may be inadmissible spends credit on an entry that may be withdrawn. The expected value of the batch was never in doubt (12 of 17 Tier 3 clips adopted, +0.089 summed AUC each); its admissibility now is.
held_pending_that_answer.resolution: CANCELLED. The 13-clip warm-start batch would have fine-tuned policies against a reference produced by a tracker whose CAD input is inadmissible, so it could not have produced a claimable entry at any price. The ~$8 is not spent.

compliant_tier3_route_if_disallowed.note: both ship in nvidia-isaac/video_to_data, so the intended path exists. The reconstructed mesh would feed the tracker and the simulator; the released mesh would stay only in scoring and frame-0 alignment.
compliant_tier3_route_if_disallowed.scale: a rebuild of the whole Tier 3 chain -- reconstruct 30 objects, re-retarget, re-train or warm-start 30 policies -- not a patch, and not obviously affordable in the time and credit left.
compliant_tier3_route_if_disallowed.verdict_2026_11_03: Not reachable before the 2026-11-04 22:00 UTC freeze. It needs 30 object reconstructions from video, FoundationPose re-run against each reconstruction, the simulator re-staged on the reconstructed geometry, and 30 policies re-trained -- a chain we have never run end to end, on about $28 of credit and ~25 hours. Recommendation: withdraw Tier 3 and say so in the thread.

follow_up_answered.from: Shalin Jain <shalinj@nvidia.com>, cc v2d_challenge@nvidia.com and mverghese@nvidia.com
follow_up_answered.verbatim: Thanks for the detailed questions! Your read is correct, we ask that you please reconstruct the object mesh for your Tier 3 object tracking and simulation efforts. For the object name, you're welcome to use AI-generated subject names as an alternative.
follow_up_answered.settles: Both disputed uses are disallowed. 'Your read is correct' answers the question as asked -- the read offered was that (b) the tracker's CAD input and (c) the simulator's object geometry are BOTH inadmissible and that the compliant route is our own reconstruction for both, keeping the released mesh only for scoring and frame-0 alignment. The second sentence also rules out meta/episodes_metadata.jsonl as the detection prompt, offering AI-generated names instead.
follow_up_answered.effect_on_tier3: The live Tier 3 entry (0.26781 AUC, 6th of 13) DOES NOT ADHERE. It is not a borderline reading: the released mesh is the tracker's CAD model and the simulator's collision geometry in every one of its 30 clips.
